name: Breathless Ribbons: Fissures in Time
source:
The adoration of the 7 Elemental Gods is the key to not only saving your family, but also your home world. The catch? You have three months to do it… and time is ticking.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
对七位元素神的崇拜不仅是拯救你的家人，也是拯救你的家园的关键。收获是什么？你有三个月的时间来做这件事……时间在流逝。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
